title: RRB ALP 2026 Notification OUT - 11,127 Vacancies, Apply Online by June 14 at rrbapply.gov.in
author: Ash K.
summary: Railway Recruitment Board released RRB ALP CEN 01/2026 notification on May 14 for 11,127 Assistant Loco Pilot vacancies. Apply online at rrbapply.gov.in from May 15 to June 14, 2026. Eligibility: 10th pass + ITI or Diploma/Degree in Engineering. Age: 18–30 years. Selection: CBT 1, CBT 2, CBAT, Medical. Application fee: ₹500 (refundable on appearing in CBT 1).
body: The Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has officially released the RRB ALP 2026 notification (CEN 01/2026) for 11,127 Assistant Loco Pilot vacancies across all 21 Railway Recruitment Boards and 17 Railway Zones. The online application window is open from May 15 to June 14, 2026 at rrbapply.gov.in. With 20 days left to apply, this is one of the biggest railway recruitment opportunities this year.

DetailInformation
Notification ReleasedMay 14, 2026 (CEN 01/2026)
Total Vacancies11,127 Assistant Loco Pilot posts
Apply Start DateMay 15, 2026
Last Date to ApplyJune 14, 2026
Application Websiterrbapply.gov.in
Application Fee (General/OBC/EWS)₹500 (₹400 refunded after CBT 1)
Application Fee (SC/ST/Ex-SM/Women/PwBD)₹250 (refunded after CBT 1)
Age Limit18–30 years as on July 1, 2026
Age RelaxationSC/ST: 5 years | OBC-NCL: 3 years | Ex-SM: as per rules
Educational Qualification10th pass + ITI (relevant trade) OR Diploma/Degree in Engineering
Selection ProcessCBT 1 → CBT 2 → CBAT → Document Verification → Medical
Pay Scale₹19,900/month + allowances (7th Pay Commission, Level 2)
One RRB RestrictionCandidates can apply to only one RRB

What is the RRB ALP job? An Assistant Loco Pilot operates trains under the supervision of a Loco Pilot, monitoring controls, signals, and track while assisting with safe train movement. The career progression is strong: ALP → Loco Pilot (Goods) → Loco Pilot (Mail/Express) → Senior Loco Pilot → Loco Supervisor/Inspector. It is a Group C central government post with job security, railway passes, and 7th Pay Commission benefits.

How to apply: Visit rrbapply.gov.in → Register with mobile number and email → Fill in personal, educational, and trade details → Upload photo and signature → Pay application fee → Submit and note your Registration Number. Candidates must apply to only one RRB - applying to multiple RRBs leads to rejection of all applications. Choose the RRB based on your preferred zone or state posting.

CBT 1 exam pattern: 75 questions, 75 marks, 60 minutes. Sections: Mathematics (20 Qs), General Intelligence & Reasoning (25 Qs), General Science (20 Qs), General Awareness on Current Affairs (10 Qs). Minimum qualifying marks: 40% General/OBC/EWS, 30% SC, 25% ST. Negative marking: 1/3 mark per wrong answer.

ITI trade eligibility: Trades recognised include Electrician, Electronics Mechanic, Wireman, Fitter, Machinist, Welder, Mechanic (Diesel), Mechanic (Motor Vehicle), Tractor Mechanic, and several others. Engineering diploma/degree holders in relevant branches are also eligible. Check the official notification PDF for the complete list of eligible trades. See our RRB NTPC exam guide for more railway recruitment opportunities, or PM Kisan Yojana guide for farmer welfare schemes.

faqs.question: What is the last date to apply for RRB ALP 2026?
faqs.answer: The last date to apply for RRB ALP 2026 (CEN 01/2026) is June 14, 2026. Applications must be submitted online at rrbapply.gov.in. The application window opened on May 15, 2026.

faqs.question: How many vacancies are in RRB ALP 2026?
faqs.answer: RRB ALP 2026 (CEN 01/2026) has 11,127 vacancies for the post of Assistant Loco Pilot across all 21 Railway Recruitment Boards and 17 Railway Zones in India.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for RRB ALP 2026?
faqs.answer: Candidates must have passed Class 10 (Matriculation) plus ITI in a relevant trade, OR hold a Diploma or Degree in Engineering in a relevant branch. Age limit is 18 to 30 years as on July 1, 2026, with relaxation for reserved categories.

faqs.question: What is the application fee for RRB ALP 2026?
faqs.answer: General, OBC, and EWS candidates pay ₹500, of which ₹400 is refunded after appearing in CBT 1. SC, ST, Ex-Servicemen, Women, and PwBD candidates pay ₹250, which is refunded after CBT 1.

faqs.question: Can I apply to multiple RRBs for RRB ALP 2026?
faqs.answer: No. Candidates can apply to only one RRB for RRB ALP 2026. Applying to multiple RRBs will result in rejection of all applications. Choose your RRB carefully based on preferred posting zone.

faqs.question: What is the selection process for RRB ALP 2026?
faqs.answer: The selection process consists of CBT 1 (Stage I), CBT 2 (Stage II), Computer-Based Aptitude Test (CBAT) for ALP, Document Verification, and Medical Examination. Loco Pilot candidates also undergo a skill test instead of CBAT.

callout.heading: 20 Days Left - Apply Before June 14
callout.content: The RRB ALP 2026 application window closes June 14. Don't wait for the last day - server load on deadline day causes login failures. Apply at rrbapply.gov.in today. Keep your ITI certificate, 10th marksheet, photo and signature ready before starting the form.
